thought.text: Database state confirms bootstrap completed correctly. Now let me verify the critical SSO behavior — first with the existing tokens, then a fresh end-to-end SSO login.

reasoning_content:
Database state has been confirmed: `bootstrap_completed=true`, `instance_name=localhost`, `oidc_issuer=http://dex:5556/dex`, and the claims are also properly configured. Migrations have been executed (schema_migrations table exists, and the full set of tables is also in place).

What to do next is the most important behavior test: SSO Matrix login flow. According to the summary, the flow is as follows:
1. GET /_matrix/client/v3/login/sso/redirect/oidc?redirectUrl=... → 302 to Dex
2. Dex login (form POST including username/password, CSRF)
3. Callback → loginToken
4. POST /_matrix/client/v3/login using m.login.token

As verification, let's execute this flow end-to-end using kai@example.com (admin), and additionally also do alex@example.com. Also verify whether the existing tokens in /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/ still work (the server was restarted 7 minutes ago — the token is in postgres so it should still work).

First, let's check /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/ and test the existing alex token against whoami.

action.command: ls -la /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---alex whoami---"; ALEX_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/alex_token.txt 2>/dev/null); echo "token len: ${#ALEX_TOKEN}"; curl -sS -m 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ALEX_TOKEN" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "ls -la /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/ 2>/dev/null; echo \"---alex whoami---\"; ALEX_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/nebu-bootstrap/alex_token.txt 2>/dev/null); echo \"token len: ${#ALEX_TOKEN}\"; curl -sS -m 10 -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ALEX_TOKEN\" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami -w '\\nHTTP:%{http_code}\\n'", "summary": "Verify existing Matrix access token with whoami", "security_risk": "LOW"}

summary: Verify existing Matrix access token with whoami
